name: Archbee
description: Archbee describes itself as "The First Knowledge Portal Platform," helping organizations turn static documentation into searchable, interactive knowledge portals, serving 3,000+ organizations per the site.
best_for: Technical teams scaling documentation, and companies building customer-facing knowledge portals to reduce support ticket volume through self-service docs.
features: Native Git-like branching for isolated editing with review/merge
Reusable snippets and dynamic variables that propagate across docs
AI-assisted writing and AI-powered instant answers
Custom domain hosting with SEO/AEO/GEO optimization and in-app embedding
1,800+ integrations (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Slack, Jira, Zapier); SOC2/GDPR/DPF certified

alternatives.name: ReadMe
alternatives.description: An API-documentation platform with an interactive OpenAPI-driven explorer and Git-based sync.

alternatives.name: Document360
alternatives.description: An AI-powered knowledge base for internal and external documentation across many industries.
